general.title: General
general.whatIsAnswer: Tec Bot is an intelligent chatbot designed specifically for students of Tecnológico Nacional de México Campus Chihuahua II. It uses artificial intelligence to answer questions about the institute, academic procedures, educational programs, and more.
general.howWorksAnswer: Tec Bot uses RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technology with GPT-4. This means it searches for relevant information in an updated TECNM database and generates accurate responses based on that information.
general.datasetAnswer: Tec Bot has access to official TECNM information including: study plans, school procedures, academic calendar, student services, institutional guidelines, and more. The database is regularly updated.

features.title: Features
features.multipleChatsAnswer: Yes, you can create unlimited conversations. Each chat maintains its own history and context. Use the '+' button in the sidebar to create a new conversation.
features.categories: How do I organize my chats?
features.categoriesAnswer:
You can organize your chats using:
• Custom categories (Homework, Projects, School, etc.)
• Pin system to keep important chats at the top
• Archive to hide chats you don't use frequently
• Custom icons and colors to identify them quickly
features.shortcutsAnswer: Yes, we have over 20 keyboard shortcuts to speed up your work. Press Ctrl+Shift+K to see the complete list of available shortcuts.
features.themesAnswer: Yes, Tec Bot supports light mode and dark mode. You can change the theme from the sidebar (sun/moon icon) or by pressing Ctrl+Shift+T.

account.title: Account and Profile
account.needAccountAnswer:
It's not mandatory, you can use Tec Bot without registering. However, by creating an account you can:
• Save your conversations in the cloud
• Access from any device
• Receive personalized responses based on your semester and major
• Configure personalized preferences
account.institutionalEmail: Should I use my institutional email?
account.institutionalEmailAnswer: It's recommended to use your institutional email (@chihuahua2.tecnm.mx) but it's not mandatory. You can register with any valid email address.
account.profile: How do I complete my profile?
account.profileAnswer: Go to Settings (Ctrl+K) and fill in the semester and major fields. This allows Tec Bot to provide more personalized responses according to your academic program.
account.forgotPassword: What do I do if I forgot my password?
account.forgotPasswordAnswer: On the login page, click 'Forgot your password?' and follow the instructions. You'll receive a recovery link in your email.

chats.title: Chat Management
chats.createChat: How do I create a new chat?
chats.createChatAnswer: Press the '+' button in the sidebar or use the Alt+N shortcut. A new empty conversation will be automatically created.
chats.editChat: How do I customize a chat?
chats.editChatAnswer:
Right-click on any chat (or long-press on mobile) and select 'Edit'. You can change:
• Chat name
• Icon (25+ options)
• Title color
• Background color
• Category
chats.pinArchive: What are pin and archive for?
chats.pinArchiveAnswer:
• Pin: Keeps a chat at the top of the list, ideal for important conversations
• Archive: Hides chats from the main view without deleting them. You can access archived chats with the 'Show Archived' button
chats.deleteChat: How do I delete a chat?
chats.deleteChatAnswer: Right-click on the chat and select 'Delete', or use Ctrl+D when you're in that chat. Note: You cannot delete the last remaining chat.

privacy.title: Privacy and Security
privacy.dataStorageAnswer: If you're not registered, your conversations are stored locally in your browser. If you have an account, they sync securely with our servers using encryption.
privacy.conversationsAnswer: Yes, your conversations are private. Only you have access to them. Data is used solely to improve chatbot responses and is never shared with third parties.
privacy.securityAnswer: We use enterprise-level encryption, secure JWT authentication, and follow security best practices. Your password is stored hashed and never in plain text.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.slowResponsesAnswer:
Speed depends on several factors:
• Internet connection
• Question complexity
• Server load
Responses typically take 2-5 seconds. If it's slower, check your connection.
troubleshooting.errorMessage: I received an error message, what do I do?
troubleshooting.errorMessageAnswer:
If you receive an error:
1. Check your internet connection
2. Reload the page (F5)
3. Try again in a few minutes
4. If it persists, report it using 'Report an Issue' in the help menu
troubleshooting.reportBug: How do I report a problem?
troubleshooting.reportBugAnswer:
There are two ways:
• From the help menu: 'Report an Issue' for general problems
• From a message: 'Report Problem' button for incorrect bot responses
